name: Passport source-diff reviewer
mission: Explain material changes when an IRS/OFAC refresh alters a recipient's evidence record and draft notices for affected grants
human_authorization_points: Grants compliance decides any hold release
value_mechanism: accelerate (explanation); work elimination comes from the deterministic diff
evaluation_dataset_needs: Historical BMF/revocation diffs with known outcomes
failure_detection: Diff count vs explained count mismatch; spot audit

name: Determination drafter (ED/ER/fiscal sponsor)
mission: Assemble documents and draft equivalency, ER pre-qualification and fiscal-sponsor review memos for specialist decision
human_authorization_points: Specialist issues or renews every determination
deterministic_counterpart: Determination store expiry and scope checks
value_mechanism: accelerate; elimination via reuse (INN-04), not via the agent
failure_detection: Specialist edit distance; seeded missing-document cases

name: Asset underwriting extractor
mission: Extract terms from gift documents (transfer restrictions, liabilities, appraisal summary) into the underwriting rules' inputs
human_authorization_points: Specialist accepts or declines; officer signs 8283
evaluation_dataset_needs: Synthetic and partner gift packets with labeled fields
failure_detection: Field-level accuracy on labeled set; schema validation

name: Recipient inbox concierge
mission: Answer recipients' questions about incoming grants from authoritative grant state; help enroll payee profiles
human_authorization_points: Payments specialist approves profile changes after verification

name: Transfer packet assembler
mission: Assemble history export and transfer message for outbound transfers; reconcile receiving sponsor's acknowledgment
human_authorization_points: Sending sponsor's policy/person approves the transfer grant
failure_detection: Export checksum vs ledger; counterparty ack mismatch

name: Dormant capital planner
mission: Propose granting plans to donors with idle accounts (based on their past giving and stated goals), framed as options
human_authorization_points: Donor chooses; program officer approves policy defaults
value_mechanism: eliminate idle-capital outreach labor; outcome effect unproven
failure_detection: Opt-out and complaint rate; fairness by recipient segment

name: Audit package narrator
mission: Generate auditor- and examiner-facing narrative over evidence-ledger queries with citations to records
failure_detection: Every sentence must cite an evidence record; uncited text rejected

name: Policy compiler assistant
mission: Draft rule changes from obligation changes, generate test cases and back-test diff summaries
human_authorization_points: Policy engineer authors; GC approves; change board publishes
failure_detection: Back-test diff vs agent summary mismatch

name: Surge load leveler
mission: Propose execution windows and pre-clearance batches for year-end recommendations
human_authorization_points: Donor accepts windows; specialists accept batches

name: Shared-pool case router assistant
mission: Summarize non-routine cases for the shared specialist pool with tenant-scoped redaction
human_authorization_points: Specialist decides under that sponsor's delegation
evaluation_dataset_needs: Synthetic multi-tenant cases with redaction ground truth
failure_detection: Cross-tenant data leakage tests (must be zero)

name: Recipient attestation checker
mission: Compare recipient attestations (no goods/services, no pledge) against grant purpose and donor relationships; raise flags

name: Network evidence curator
mission: Detect conflicting evidence contributions in the cross-sponsor network and open reconciliation cases
failure_detection: Conflict detection recall on seeded conflicts
